arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS prepaid_debit_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions made on cards whose type is prepaid debit, across the full data range.
assumptions: The count covers all transactions regardless of whether they have a fraud label.
The data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, so the count covers that whole period.
